pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/resilience/mod.rs:21 The resilience module scores extraction health using pure statistical detectors over stored revision history, with no LLM in the decision. A search of crates/core for benchmark, scorecard, prompt_variant, thinking_budget and anonymiz found nothing, so this context runs no provider × model × prompt-variant benchmark matrix and the subject's precondition does not hold.
